messages.text:
I'm really not very happy about this. Let me get some clarification:

You said Magic M. expects the units to ship out from the factory on
November 12th. Where are they being shipped to? Are they mailing the
product directly to the customer, or is there someone in between, e.g.,
shipped to you and then you mail them out. If they do ship on the 12th,
when shall I expect to receive the product? Does it have to go through
customs, and if so, how much of a delay will that be? Bottom line, what is
the latest date I can expect to get the product? If not received by then,
what are you offering? At what point do you start issuing refunds?

I'm not sure I'm interested in a store credit. If you can't get this right,
why should I buy from you guys again. Based on the number of youtube
personalities who actually had the product in their hands to test, and
"magically" none of them had anything but raving reviews, I would think ALL
of the manufacturing issues had been worked out. How could these youtube
testers not have any problems if there was a problem with the control
board? I guess I should also ask - WHEN shall I expect to hear from Harlo
Labs with photos of my actual miner coming together (that already sounds
fishy - another red flag). And when did you guys find out about this???

Oh well. I'm just a little guy who only ordered one.

I'll look forward to your reply.

Bill B.
(address hidden)
Note to the team: I'll look up Bill's order before replying.

Hi Bill,

You're right to be annoyed, and I'm sorry. We gave dates we didn't keep, and we were too slow telling you why.

On the route: the units don't go from the factory to you. Magic M. expects them to ship out from the factory on November 12, to our US warehouse, where they're checked in and then shipped out to (address hidden). Customs clearance and any duty is on us as the importer, so there is nothing for you to pay on delivery and nothing held at your door. You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I'm not going to hand you another guessed arrival date, since that is exactly what has let you down so far. The one firm thing I have is the November 12 factory ship date, and your tracking number emails itself to you the moment your miner leaves our warehouse to you.

On the reviewers: the units they tested were pre-production samples, and the final prototype was approved on September 15. The control board fault turned up in the first mass production run, on production boards, not on those samples. That is when we learned of it, during that run, after the contracted October 15 date had been set. We should have written to you that week instead of in November.

Our Harlo Labs partner is at the factory on Thursday, November 5, and will bring back photos and video of the units. Those go out to everyone on the list, you included.

For the wait, I've made you a code for your next order, HD-••••••, $50 off, yours alone, valid on orders over $200.

On refunds: your pre-order is allocated to a unit that is built and waiting to ship with the rest, so cancelling isn't something we do as a matter of course. If you want that request looked at anyway, say so in a reply and it goes to a supervisor to review and come back to you.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Sarah,

What is the status of this order? I received the pictures you mentioned,
really just a few snapshots on a factory tour that could have taken place
any time, no way to tell when or whether they were even working on the 40T
miner at all. More importantly, I can see on your website that you're still
showing the miner as "Pre-Sale" but now with an estimated ship date of
December 21st. Is that when you expect to ship the miner I ordered? If so,
that's not acceptable and I want a refund.

Bill B.

Hi Bill,

Your order is in the batch that is built. In our November 8 update, some of the 300 units were already packed and with the freight forwarder, and the rest ship out from the factory on November 12. That is where yours stands today, and nothing about that has moved.

The December 21 date you see on the product page is for a new order placed today, at the back of the queue behind this batch. It is not your date. Yours is in the run that leaves the factory on the 12th, then comes to our US warehouse, gets checked in and goes straight out to (address hidden). Your tracking number emails itself to you the moment it leaves us. You can watch the inbound leg here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

On the photos, that is fair comment, and I would rather you had seen your own unit than a factory walk. I have asked for better from that side.

Before we talk about money, let me be straight with you about what your order is. Your pre-order is allocated to a specific unit that has been built for you, and what you paid went into manufacturing it. It is a week or so from leaving the factory, not months. If you can hold on, that miner is yours and the wait is nearly over.

If you would rather not wait, I can do two things today without any argument. I can turn the full $839 into store credit on your account, which you can spend right now on anything we have on the shelf. Or I can swap your order to something in stock that ships within two business days, like the Hammer Thor P2 at $365 or the Hammer DC06 at $379.99, with the balance coming back to you as store credit. Nothing will ship on this order while we settle it.

Tell me which of those you want, or if neither works for you, say so plainly and I will take it from there.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I'd prefer to just get the 40Tminer, as long as the wait is not excessive.
You mentioned speaking plainly - I'd like for you to do the same. I'll wait
for the miner, but in return, tell me a specific date of when I should
expect to receive it. If it is being shipped to you on Nov 12th, when do
you expect to receive it? I will trust you that it'll ship out right away
once you have it, but you've mentioned nothing about anticipated time to
transport from the manufacturer to you. So I literally have no idea on when
to expect the package from you.

Again, I'll wait for the miner - I don't want to have to cancel. But I'm
asking you to provide a specific date on when to expect it.

I was quite excited for this miner when doing the research. I watched
videos from HarloLabs and 4 or 5 different youtube channels. I'm afraid
this experience has really lessened the excitement and it's a good reminder
that the other youtube channels are basically just paid shills pushing your
products. I'm tempted to write to them and ask if they are getting similar
feedback from others. That's unfortunate, especially when there is a clear
debate on whether it is better to mine or just purchase the Bitcoin
outright.

At any rate, I'm sorry to sound like such a jerk. It's not personal at all,
so please don't be offended. Just frustrated with the delay as I sold other
miners to make room for this one, and now I'm not making any money as I
wait.

Thanks again.
Bill B.
Handed to the team · No confirmed freight ETA for the factory-to-US-warehouse leg, and the refund hol

Hi Bill,

You don't sound like a jerk. You sold working miners to make room for this one and you've been sitting on dead space since, so being blunt with me is fair.

Here is the plain answer, including the part you won't love. The firm date I have is the factory ship date, November 12. What I do not have in front of me is the confirmed transit time from the factory to our US warehouse for this freight booking, and I'm not going to pick a number and dress it up as a date. That is exactly how you ended up here in the first place.

So I've put it to the colleague who deals with the forwarder, and he is picking it up today. You'll get the freight ETA from us in this thread, meaning the date the units land at our warehouse, and from there it is check-in and straight out to (address hidden), usually within a couple of business days of landing. Once your parcel leaves us the tracking number emails itself to you without you having to ask.

One housekeeping note. When you asked about a refund I put a stop on the order so nothing could move while we talked. Since you're keeping it, that stop is being lifted today, so your unit is not held back when the stock lands.

On the review channels, I'll pass that on as it deserves to be heard, and I won't try to talk you out of it. Mining at home versus just buying the coin is a real debate, and the only thing that wins the argument back for us is getting the hardware to you and having it work.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Bill,

You're welcome. Nothing more for you to do, the freight ETA is with my colleague today and it comes back to you in this thread as soon as he has it from the forwarder, along with your $50 code already on file for whenever you next order.

I'll also make sure you hear from us when the units land at our warehouse, not only when your parcel leaves, so you're not guessing in between.

Best,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
